title: Palmated
summary: PAL'MATED, adjective [Latin palmatus, from palma, palm.] 1. Having the shape of a hand; resembling a hand with the fingers spread; as palmated leaves or stones. 2. Entirely webbed; as the palmated fee

inlines.v: PAL'MATED, adjective [Latin palmatus, from palma, palm.] 1. Having the shape of a hand; resembling a hand with the fingers spread; as palmated leaves or stones. 2. Entirely webbed; as the palmated feet of aquatic fowls.
